name: bfb
description: A provider-neutral control plane for humans and coding agents.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps packages tools prettier.config.mjs vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:protocol: pnpm protocol:check && vitest run packages/protocol-ts/test && go test ./internal/protocol/...
scripts.test:substrate: vitest run apps/control-worker/test/env.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/wrangler-config.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/substrate-auth-spike.test.ts apps/artifact-worker/test/env.test.ts apps/web/test/routes.test.ts && pnpm --filter @bfb/control-worker build && pnpm --filter @bfb/artifact-worker build && pnpm build:web && pnpm exec tsc -b tools/substrate --pretty false && tsx tools/substrate/run.ts
scripts.test:db: vitest run packages/db/test && pnpm exec tsc -b tools/db --pretty false && tsx tools/db/run.ts
scripts.test:c01: pnpm exec tsc -b tools/kernel --pretty false && vitest run packages/domain/test/hub.test.ts packages/domain/test/abuse.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/hub-client.test.ts && tsx tools/kernel/run.ts
scripts.test:c02: pnpm build && vitest run packages/domain/test/identity.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/session-security.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/auth-configuration.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/auth-integration.test.ts apps/artifact-worker/test/env.test.ts && pnpm --filter @bfb/control-worker build && pnpm build:web && pnpm exec tsc -b tools/identity --pretty false && tsx tools/identity/run.ts
scripts.test:c03: pnpm build && vitest run packages/domain/test/step-up.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/auth-configuration.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/passkey-routes.test.ts && tsx tools/passkeys/run.ts && pnpm test:c03:browser
scripts.test:c04: pnpm build && vitest run packages/domain/test/authorization.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/workspace-authorization-routes.test.ts && pnpm exec tsc -b tools/workspace-authorization --pretty false && tsx tools/workspace-authorization/run.ts
scripts.test:c07: pnpm build && vitest run packages/domain/test/projects.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/project-routes.test.ts && tsx tools/projects/run.ts
scripts.test:c08: pnpm build && vitest run packages/domain/test/work.test.ts packages/domain/test/projections.test.ts packages/domain/test/mcp.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/work-routes.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/mcp-handler.test.ts && pnpm exec tsc -b tools/work-records --pretty false && tsx tools/work-records/run.ts
scripts.test:w01: pnpm build && pnpm test:w01:unit && pnpm test:w01:browser
scripts.test:x03a: vitest run packages/domain/test/mcp.test.ts packages/domain/test/oauth.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/mcp-handler.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/routes.test.ts apps/control-worker/test/d1-adapter.test.ts && pnpm test:x03a:browser
scripts.test:ic1: pnpm test:domain && pnpm test:w01 && pnpm test:x03a
